name: codex-rate-limit-exporter
description: Export last-observed Codex quota state to the existing OTel gateway.

interface.shortDescription: Exports Codex quota snapshots via plugin hooks.
interface.longDescription: Reads the latest Codex session token_count event, extracts the 5-hour and 7-day quota windows, and exports that snapshot to the existing OTel gateway without running a daemon.
defaultPrompt: Use the local Codex quota exporter hooks when this plugin is enabled.
